topography.project_purpose: Privacy. Structurally: 27 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 13 common project-authored base contract(s) (ownable2step, context, ierc777). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
